dialogues.speaker: Viliana
dialogues.text: Huh? Hmm... Judging by your expression, you haven't been to Snezhnaya yet, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Viliana
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're right! Compared to Augury Birds like Miss Linnea, whom you'd only ever read about in books, we Snegurochka are among the most numerous fae out there.

dialogues.speaker: Viliana
dialogues.text: It's just that... as you can probably guess, our kind generally loathe the heat. So we seldom leave the northern snowfields.

dialogues.speaker: Viliana
dialogues.text: For my mother, a titled lord honored by Her Majesty the Tsaritsa, letting me travel solo like this is an incredible concession. Meeting you is truly a privilege made possible by her rare leniency.

dialogues.speaker: Viliana
dialogues.text: My distant aunt, on the other hand, the Grand Duchess Pavlina of the House of Hesperides, has completely sealed off her territory, refusing to let a single one of her subjects venture out into the world...

dialogues.speaker: Viliana
dialogues.text: Though... I suppose she has her reasons. Anyway, once you visit our beautiful city, you won't be surprised by Snegurochka anymore!
